configurations.name: niuu-platform-bridge
runtimeArgs:
import socket,threading,sys
def pipe(a,b):
    try:
        while True:
            d=a.recv(65536)
            if not d: break
            b.sendall(d)
    except OSError: pass
    finally:
        try: b.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
        except OSError: pass
s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); s.bind(('127.0.0.1',8081)); s.listen(64)
print('bridge 127.0.0.1:8081 -> 192.168.1.106:8080', flush=True)
while True:
    c,_=s.accept()
    u=socket.socket(); u.connect(('192.168.1.106',8080))
    threading.Thread(target=pipe,args=(c,u),daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=pipe,args=(u,c),daemon=True).start()
